title: Meets Expectations
text:
I've been wanting an opportunity to try different types of coffee without major investment or expense. This subscription box came up as I was exploring other subscription boxes. Looking at the description and the price, I figured I had nothing to lose so I subscribed.

First box has arrived. It was a bit of a rocky start as there seemed to be some confusion with the package tracker. I appreciate that the coffee is packaged properly in a resealable packet and the cookies were a nice surprise - bigger than I anticipated and they survived shipping during a heat wave.

Coffee love can be a bit subjective. Each blend and roast won't be a favorite to everyone. This first blend was nice, but I'm not sure I'd look for it on my own. It will be interesting to see what comes next month.

If you are looking for an economical way to try new flavors, this might be what you are looking for.
label: positive
